settings.general.themeNote: Light theme will arrive in a later version.

settings.capture.clipboardAuto: Automatically copy captures to the clipboard

settings.capture.includeCursorNote: Not supported by the capture engine yet — coming later.
settings.capture.captureAllScreens: Full screen: capture all screens (otherwise, the screen under the cursor)
settings.shortcuts.hint: Click a field then press the desired combination. Escape to cancel.
settings.shortcuts.conflict: This shortcut is already used by another application.
aide.label: Explanation
settings.help.delayed: Waits a few seconds before capturing: time to open a menu or hover a button. Set the delay in Capture.
settings.help.delayed.ex: Ctrl+Shift+D → 5 s to open the menu, then capture
settings.help.region: Drag a rectangle with the mouse: only that area is captured.
settings.help.region.ex: Ctrl+Shift+S → drag over a table → copied
settings.help.url: The address of your MultiOutils site, with its port if it has one. Leave empty to stay offline.
settings.help.token: The key that lets the app send captures to the site. It is kept encrypted on this PC.
settings.help.token.ex: Site → Administration → API tokens → “Generate a token”, then paste it here (mo_…)
settings.help.dir: The folder where each capture is saved. Pick a synced folder to find your captures elsewhere.
settings.help.template: The name given to each file. Words in braces are replaced when the capture is taken.
settings.help.trash: A deleted capture stays in the gallery trash for this many days, then it is erased for good.
settings.help.trash.ex: 30: deleted on 4 November → erased on 4 December
settings.about.blurb: Modular toolbox for Windows — screen capture and management. Local-first, no telemetry.
settings.about.flow: The launcher recreates the core features of Flow Launcher (MIT licence).
wizard.title: Welcome to MultiOutils
wizard.subtitle: A few settings before you start — everything can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.folder.help: Captures will be saved in this folder.
wizard.shortcuts.help: Default shortcuts (editable later in Settings → Shortcuts):
wizard.autostart.help: MultiOutils can start with Windows and live in the system tray.
wizard.trayNote: All set! The MultiOutils icon is in the notification area (system tray).

library.folder.none: No folders yet — create one with +
library.folder.confirmDelete: Delete folder “{name}”? Its captures will become “Unsorted”, subfolders move up one level.
library.tag.none: No tags yet — create one with +
library.tag.confirmDelete: Delete tag “{name}”? It will be removed from all captures.
settings.updates.how: The app checks the public repository's GitHub Releases, only when you click. “Update” downloads the new version, installs it without a wizard and restarts MultiOutils. Updates are never forced.
settings.updates.devMode: Unavailable in development mode (app launched from sources, without an installer).
settings.updates.autoRestart: MultiOutils will restart on its own when done, no install steps.
settings.server.help: The server is OPTIONAL: the app works 100% offline. A capture is only sent when you click “Send to server” — never automatically.
settings.server.tokenSaved: A token is saved (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it.
settings.server.howTo: Generate the token on the site: Administration → API tokens → “Generate a token” (see docs/02 §3.4).
settings.server.testBadToken: The server responds, but the token is invalid or missing.
settings.server.testUnreachable: Server unreachable — check the URL (and that the site is running).
quickbar.sendNotConfigured: Configure the server first (Settings → Remote server)
remote.state.error: Send failed — click “Send to server” to retry
remote.notConfigured: Server not configured: Settings → Remote server
notif.sendErrors: {n} upload(s) failed — red indicator on the captures concerned
colorpicker.title: Color picker
colorpicker.help: Full screen with magnifier: click the pixel you want, its code is copied to the clipboard. Also available in the tray menu.
colorpicker.hint: Click a pixel — Escape to cancel
clips.title: Clipboard
clips.help: Every copy (Ctrl+C) is added here. Drag & drop a file (PDF, doc, zip…) or use “Add a file”. Pin what you want to keep — the rest is deleted automatically (configurable delay in settings). Texts, photos and files shared from your iPhone/iPad also land here.
clips.addFileTooltip: Choose one or more files (PDF, doc, zip…) to add
clips.tooLarge: File too large for the server (limit set by the administrator)
clips.openSiteTooltip: Open the site's Clips page in the browser — useful to find an item that's no longer in the local list
clips.empty: Nothing here yet. Copy some text or an image, or share from your iPhone.
clips.copyTooltip: Click to copy back to the clipboard
clips.folder.confirmDelete: Delete folder “{name}”? Its items become “Unsorted”, its subfolders move up one level.
clips.tag.confirmDelete: Delete tag “{name}”? It will be removed from all items.
clips.sendError: Failed to send to the server
clips.noTagsYet: No tags yet — create one with the + in the sidebar.
clips.fromPhone: Received from your iPhone or iPad (via the server)
clips.settings.hint: “Kept” (pinned) items and anything sent to the server (or received from iPhone/iPad) are never deleted automatically — only other purely local items are purged after this delay. Copies flagged as sensitive by password managers are ignored. Sending to the server always stays an explicit action.
autoclick.title: Auto-clicker
autoclick.name: Profile name
autoclick.unavailable: Auto-clicking is only available on Windows (native module unavailable here).
autoclick.help: Clicks automatically at the current cursor position. Place the cursor where you want, then start.
autoclick.streamdeckHint: Also controllable from the Stream Deck (action "Auto-clicker toggle").
autoclick.notif.windowsOnly: Auto-clicking is only available on Windows.
ocr.firstUse: First use: the language model (~15 MB) is downloaded once then cached — later runs work offline.
ocr.empty: No readable text detected in this capture.
editor.loadError: Could not load the capture image.

launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.provider.websearch.desc: Engines with a keyword (g, yt, w…)
launcher.provider.system.desc: Shut down, lock, empty the Recycle Bin…
launcher.action.useResult: Put the result in the search bar
launcher.calc.subtitle: {expr} · Enter to copy
launcher.history.subtitle: Recent search
launcher.kill.subtitle: {n} process(es) · {mem} · PID {pids}
launcher.panel.blurb: A search bar that opens anywhere with a shortcut: launch a program, find a file, calculate, search the web or trigger a MultiOutils tool. A recreation of Flow Launcher's core features.
launcher.credit: Inspired by Flow Launcher (MIT license, © 2019 Flow-Launcher, © 2015 Wox) — see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Third-party plugins are not supported.
launcher.reg.sourcesIntro: What the launcher searches while you type. Turn off what you don't use.
launcher.reg.keywordsHelp: Without a keyword, a source mixes its results with all the others. With a keyword, type it followed by a space to search only there (a symbol like “>” sticks to the text). Click a keyword to change it.
launcher.reg.keywordsHelp.ex:
f invoice   → files only
>ipconfig   → commands only
launcher.reg.enginesHelp: Each engine has a name, a keyword and an address where {q} is replaced by your search. Add any site you like.
launcher.reg.urlHelp: Put {q} where the searched text goes.
launcher.reg.dangerIntro: These actions cannot be undone: you are asked to confirm first.
launcher.reg.p.files: Finds a file or browses a folder
launcher.reg.p.shell: Runs a cmd or PowerShell command
launcher.reg.p.system: Shut down, lock, empty the bin…
launcher.help.programs: Searches the Start menu, the desktop and Store apps. Initials work too, and what you often pick moves to the top.
launcher.help.programs.ex:
chrome   → Google Chrome
vsc      → Visual Studio Code
launcher.help.files: Finds a file by name. Type a path to browse folders: Tab completes the name, Enter opens it.
launcher.help.files.ex:
f invoice    → files named “invoice”
C:\Users\    → browses the folder
launcher.help.calculator: Type a calculation: the result shows at once and Enter copies it. Comma works like a dot.
launcher.help.websearch: Type an engine's keyword, a space, then your search. Engines are set further down.
launcher.help.websearch.ex:
g cats       → Google
yt guitar    → YouTube
w Paris      → Wikipedia
launcher.help.url: Recognises a web address and opens it in your default browser.
launcher.help.shell: Type “>” right before the command, then Enter to run it. Commands you already ran are suggested again.
launcher.help.system: Windows commands by name. Those that end the session ask for confirmation.
launcher.help.winsettings: Opens a Windows Settings or Control Panel page directly.
launcher.help.processes: Type “kill” and a program name to force-close it: all its processes, or just one.
launcher.help.bookmarks: Reads bookmarks from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi and Firefox, then opens them in your browser.
launcher.help.tools: Starts a MultiOutils tool without going through the main window.
launcher.help.shortcut: The key combination that opens or closes the launcher from any app. Click the button, then press the keys you want; Esc cancels.
launcher.help.lastQuery: What the bar contains when you reopen the launcher.
launcher.help.lastQuery.ex:
Selected: “kill chrome” is highlighted, type to replace it
Kept: you pick up where you left off
Cleared: the bar is empty
launcher.help.maxResults: The maximum number of lines under the bar. Fewer lines means a smaller window.
launcher.help.maxResults.ex:
5  → only the 5 best results
12 → more choice at a glance
launcher.help.hideOnBlur: The launcher closes by itself when you click another window. Otherwise it stays open until Esc.
launcher.help.hideOnBlur.ex: You click the desktop → the launcher hides
launcher.help.defaultEngine: Offered as the last line of every search, even without a keyword: Enter on it searches what you typed.
launcher.help.defaultEngine.ex:
pancake recipe
→ last line: Search on Google
launcher.help.backend: How files are searched. Automatic uses Everything if installed (fastest), otherwise the Windows Search index, otherwise a folder walk.
launcher.help.folders: Extra folders in the index: their programs and files show up in results, even outside the Start menu.
launcher.help.excludes: What must never show up in results. One pattern per line: part of a path, or a name with the * wildcard.
launcher.help.index: The list of programs and bookmarks is reread at startup. Reindex after installing something so it shows up right away.
launcher.help.index.ex: You install GIMP → Reindex → “gimp” finds it
launcher.help.keepOpen: Keeps the command window open once the command is done, so you can read its output.
launcher.help.keepOpen.ex: >ipconfig → the IP address stays on screen
launcher.help.showHistory: When the bar is empty, your last searches are listed: Enter runs one again.
launcher.help.usage: The launcher remembers what you pick for each search and puts it first next time. Forgetting resets the ranking.
launcher.help.usage.ex:
“co” → you pick Code
next time, Code comes first
launcher.look.title: Bar appearance
launcher.look.intro: The preview follows every change, and so does the launcher, without restarting.
launcher.look.widthDesc: How much room the bar takes on screen
launcher.look.opacityDesc: Lower lets the desktop show through
launcher.look.radiusDesc: From almost square to very round
launcher.look.subtitlesDesc: The path or detail under each result
launcher.help.look.width: The width of the bar and results. Wider lets long file paths fit on one line.
launcher.help.look.width.ex:
560 px: discreet on a laptop
900 px: comfortable on a big screen
launcher.help.look.textSize: Scales the typed text, result titles and subtitles all at once.
launcher.help.look.textSize.ex:
115%: easier to read from afar
90%: more results in the same height
launcher.help.look.visibleRows: Beyond this, the list scrolls with the arrows or the wheel. How many results are searched is set in General.
launcher.help.look.visibleRows.ex:
12 results, 5 visible lines
→ the list scrolls from the 6th
launcher.help.look.opacity: The opacity of the bar's glass background. At 100%, the background is solid and text is easiest to read.
launcher.help.look.opacity.ex:
100%: solid background
75%: the wallpaper shows faintly behind
launcher.help.look.radius: How round the bar's corners are; the field and result lines follow.
launcher.help.look.radius.ex:
6 px: classic Windows look
28 px: very round, like a pill
launcher.help.look.position: The height where the bar opens, on the screen where the mouse is. Results are added below.
launcher.help.look.position.ex:
Top: close to browser tabs
Centre: right in your line of sight
launcher.help.look.subtitles: The small grey line under each result: file path, calculation detail, search engine…
launcher.help.look.hotkeys: Shows “Alt 1”, “Alt 2”… on the right of results. The shortcut works even when the numbers are hidden.
launcher.help.look.accent: The colour of the selected result and matched letters. “Same as app” follows Settings → Appearance.
launcher.help.look.accent.ex:
App in lavender, launcher in mint
→ you spot it at a glance
launcher.settings.shortcutDesc: Opens or closes the launcher from any application
launcher.settings.lastQueryDesc: What to do with the last search
launcher.settings.hideOnBlurDesc: The launcher closes when it loses focus
launcher.settings.showHistoryDesc: Shown when the search bar is empty
launcher.settings.providersDesc: Empty keyword = results mixed with all others; otherwise type the keyword followed by a space (or glued for a symbol such as “>”).
launcher.settings.defaultEngineDesc: Offered as the last result of every search
launcher.settings.engineHelp: {q} is replaced by the searched text
launcher.settings.everythingMissing: Everything not found: Windows Search index, then folder walk
launcher.settings.foldersDesc: Their programs and files are added to the index
launcher.settings.excludesDesc: One pattern per line: part of a path or wildcard (*.tmp)
launcher.settings.clearHistoryDesc: Recent searches and commands already run
launcher.settings.clearUsageDesc: Often chosen results move to the top
launcher.settings.maxResultsDesc: Number of rows shown under the bar
launcher.settings.clearUsageConfirm: Forget the results you pick most often? Ranking will start over.
text.noCapture: No captures yet — take one first with the Screen capture tool.
text.ocr.title: Extract text
text.ai.title: Translate (AI)
ocr.lang.sub: Language used by “Extract text” (⋯ menu of a capture). Runs locally, nothing is sent online.
reglages.sub.ai: Provider, model, target language, API key
ai.keywords: artificial intelligence claude anthropic openai gpt gemini google api key translate
ai.intro: “Translate (AI)” (⋯ menu of a capture) sends the image to the chosen AI: it reads all the visible text and translates it into the target language.
ai.privacy.title: What is sent
ai.privacy.body: Each time you use “Translate (AI)”, the capture image is sent to {provider} with your API key. It is pay-as-you-go, billed by {provider} to your account (a few cents at most per capture). Nothing is sent until you click. The key is encrypted on this PC and only leaves MultiOutils for these calls.
ai.model.help.openai: Names change over time: the current list is at platform.openai.com/docs/models. Pick a model that accepts images and JSON (structured outputs).
ai.model.help.gemini: Names change over time: the current list is at ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models. Pick a model that accepts images.
ai.target.sub: Pick from the list or type another language
ai.key.stored: Key saved, encrypted on this PC
ai.key.clearConfirm: Remove the {provider} API key from this PC?
ai.noText: No readable text found in this capture.
ai.error.noKey: No API key for this provider. Add it in Settings → AI translation.
ai.error.invalidKey: API key rejected: check it or create a new one.
ai.error.rateLimit: Provider limit reached (too many requests or no credit left). Try again in a moment.
ai.error.network: Can't reach the provider. Check your Internet connection.
ai.error.server: The provider's service is unavailable or overloaded. Try again in a moment.
ai.error.refusal: The AI declined to process this image.
ai.error.truncated: The answer was cut off (text too long). Try on a smaller area.
ai.error.badResponse: Unexpected answer from the AI. Try again.
ai.error.image: Couldn't prepare the image of this capture.
ai.error.notFound: Not found: the capture is gone, or the model doesn't exist at this provider.
ai.error.encryptionUnavailable: System encryption is unavailable: the key can't be stored safely, so it was not saved.
launcher.cat.sources.sub: Turn sources on and set their keywords
launcher.cat.aliases.sub: Two letters + Enter → a site, a folder, a program
launcher.cat.homeassistant.sub: Turn your devices on and off
launcher.plugin.keywordDesc: Empty = results mixed into every search. Otherwise type the keyword then a space.
launcher.reg.p.aliases: Exact keyword + Enter → opens the target
launcher.help.aliases: Type a shortcut's keyword then Enter: the target opens straight away. It can be a site, a folder, a file, a program or a steam:// link.
launcher.help.steam: Finds the games in all your Steam libraries. Type part of the name; Enter launches it through Steam, Ctrl+Enter opens its folder.
launcher.reg.p.homeassistant: Turns an entity on or off
launcher.help.homeassistant: Find a light, a plug, a cover, a scene… Enter toggles it. End with “on” or “off” to force.
launcher.help.homeassistant.ex:
ha living room
ha desk lamp off
ha movie scene
launcher.alias.help: A shortcut opens its target when you type its keyword then Enter. Put {q} in the target to pass text: “keyword text”.
launcher.alias.intro: Type the keyword in the bar then Enter: the site, folder or program opens straight away.
launcher.alias.name: Display name (optional)
launcher.alias.targetHelp: An address (https://…), a folder, a file, a program or a steam:// link. {q} = the text typed after the keyword.
launcher.alias.taken: Another shortcut already uses this keyword.
launcher.steam.foundDesc: Read from all your Steam libraries. After installing a game, scan again.
launcher.ha.urlDesc: The address you open in your browser.
launcher.ha.urlHelp: The local or remote address of your Home Assistant, with the port.
launcher.ha.tokenDesc: Long-lived token, kept encrypted on this PC.
launcher.ha.tokenHelp: In Home Assistant: click your profile, Security tab, “Long-lived access tokens”, then Create token. Paste it here.
launcher.ha.tokenHelp.ex: Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token
launcher.ha.testDesc: Checks the address and the token.
launcher.ha.notConfigured: Home Assistant is not set up
launcher.ha.notConfiguredSub: Add the address and token in Settings → Home Assistant.
launcher.cat.spotify.sub: Search and play your music (Spotify API)
launcher.help.spotify: Connected to your account through the Spotify API: type the keyword then a track, artist, album or playlist. Enter plays it, Ctrl+Enter adds the track to the queue. The keyword alone shows what's playing.
launcher.help.spotify.ex:
sp
sp daft punk
sp pause
sp vol 40
launcher.spotify.step1: Open Spotify's developer dashboard and sign in:
launcher.spotify.step2: Click “Create app”. Pick any name and tick “Web API”.
launcher.spotify.step3: Under “Redirect URIs”, add exactly this address and save:
launcher.spotify.step4: Copy the app's “Client ID” here, then click Connect.
launcher.spotify.clientIdDesc: Your Spotify app's ID (no secret needed).
launcher.spotify.clientIdHelp: In the Spotify dashboard, open your app then “Settings”: the Client ID is at the top. It is 32 characters.
launcher.spotify.clientIdBad: This doesn't look like a Spotify Client ID (32 characters 0-9 a-f).
launcher.spotify.notConnectedDesc: A Spotify page opens to authorise MultiOutils.
launcher.spotify.premium: Remote playback needs Spotify Premium. Without Premium, or with no active device, the item opens in the Spotify app.
launcher.spotify.err.noDevice: No active Spotify device: open Spotify and play something.
launcher.spotify.err.encryptionUnavailab: Windows encryption is unavailable: can't save the connection.
launcher.spotify.err.timeout: Timed out: the Spotify page wasn't confirmed.
ai.usage.title: Spending
ai.usage.help: {provider} doesn't tell a plain API key how much credit is left. So MultiOutils counts each translation itself: the tokens reported by the AI × the model's price. It's an estimate, made on this PC only (calls made elsewhere with the same key aren't included). The exact amount and remaining credit are on the provider's billing page.
ai.usage.resetConfirm: Clear the {provider} spending history? Nothing changes on the provider's side.
ai.usage.freeNote: Free tier: translations are counted but cost you nothing.
ai.usage.unpricedNote: Some translations have no known price: enter the model's price below to count them.
ai.usage.geminiFree.sub: AI Studio key without billing enabled: nothing is charged (usage limits apply)
ai.usage.price.known: {model}: known public price, in $ per million tokens (input, output). Fill in to change it.
ai.usage.price.custom: {model}: your price, in $ per million tokens (input, output). Empty = public price.
ai.usage.price.unknown: {model}: unknown price. Enter it in $ per million tokens (input, output) to estimate the cost.
ai.usage.thisOneUnknown: This translation: {tokens} tokens · unknown model price
ha.test.title: Test notification
ha.test.message: Home Assistant notifications will look like this.
ha.cmd.powerSub: In 30 seconds. Click Cancel to stop it.
ha.link.title: PC link
ha.link.enabled: Link this PC to Home Assistant
ha.link.enabledDesc: The PC shows up in HA with its sensors, buttons and a notification service.
ha.link.enabledHelp: MultiOutils registers like the Home Assistant mobile app ("Mobile App" integration) using the address and token above. No MQTT, no integration to install, no port to open: the PC connects to HA and keeps the connection alive (automatic reconnect after sleep or network loss).
ha.link.enabledHelp.ex: Settings → Devices & services → Mobile App → PC
ha.link.state.not-configured: Fill in the address and token above.
ha.link.state.registering: Registering this PC in Home Assistant…
ha.link.state.connected: Connected: Home Assistant can reach this PC.
ha.link.name: Name in Home Assistant
ha.link.nameDesc: "PC" if empty. Used for the service and button names.
ha.link.serviceDesc: Use it in your automations (click to copy).
ha.buttons.title: Buttons in Home Assistant
ha.buttons.enabledDesc: Scripts "PC · Veille", "PC · Verrouiller", "PC · Éteindre" and "PC · Redémarrer" for your dashboard.
ha.buttons.help: MultiOutils creates these scripts in Home Assistant if they don't exist (needs an admin token). Each has a "Run" button; you can also call them from an automation. If you edit them in HA, MultiOutils won't overwrite them.
ha.buttons.powerDesc: The PC waits 30 seconds, with a pop-up to cancel.
ha.buttons.commandsDesc: Sleep, lock, shutdown… Off: the buttons do nothing.
ha.buttons.createdDesc: Entities to add to your dashboard.
ha.sensors.title: PC sensors
ha.sensors.enabledDesc: CPU, memory, disk, PC in use, session locked, on battery.
ha.sensors.help: Only about ten useful sensors, sent when they change. Handy for automations: turn off the desk light when the PC is locked, for instance.
ha.sensors.intervalDesc: Lock and wake-up are sent right away.
ha.notif.title: Notifications on the PC
ha.notif.enabledDesc: Pop-ups sent by Home Assistant, with image and buttons.
ha.notif.help: In HA, send a notification to the service shown above, like for your phone. Supported data fields: image, icon (mdi:… or emoji), color (lavande, or, ambre, corail, menthe or #rrggbb), duration, sticky or importance: high (stays on screen), sound (false, a built-in sound, the name of one of your sounds or a URL), volume (0 to 100), position (top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right, center), size (small, normal, large), tag (replaces the previous one), url, actions. Send "clear_notification" with a tag to remove it. The "PC · Notification" script in HA offers all these fields.
ha.notif.help.ex: action: notify.mobile_app_pc · message: Laundry is done
ha.notif.durationDesc: Important notifications stay until you close them.
ha.notif.soundNameDesc: A notification can ask for another one with sound: (a sound name, a file name or a URL).
ha.notif.soundFolderDesc: Put your .mp3, .wav, .ogg or .m4a files (4 MB max) in this folder, then use their name (e.g. sound: door).
ha.notif.dndDesc: Only important notifications are shown (others stay in the history).
ha.notif.exampleDesc: Paste it into an automation action, in YAML.
ha.notif.historyDesc: Also in the launcher: type "ha notif".
ha.dash.title: Mini dashboard
ha.dash.shortcutDesc: Opens or closes the mini window from anywhere.
ha.dash.pathHelp: The end of the dashboard address, as seen in your browser.
ha.dash.hideOnBlurDesc: Like a menu. The window's pin keeps it open.
ha.dash.openDesc: Signs in automatically with your token; otherwise sign in once, the session is kept.
reglages.sub.homeassistant: PC link, notifications, buttons, mini dashboard
ha.keywords: smart home notification pop-up sleep sensors dashboard
ha.page.intro: Link this PC to your Home Assistant: on-screen notifications, Sleep / Lock / Shutdown / Restart buttons, sensors and a mini dashboard. The same connection powers the launcher's "ha" keyword.
ha.launcher.title: In the launcher
ha.launcher.desc: Turn entities on or off, open the dashboard, read received notifications.
ha.fromLauncherDesc: Set on their own page: Settings → Home Assistant.
desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.intro: Zones on your Windows desktop to group your icons or show the contents of a folder. Your files stay in the Desktop folder: a zone only displays them.
desktop.empty.title: No zones yet
desktop.empty.text: The starter layout creates Programs, Folders, Documents and Images zones with the icons already on your desktop, plus a “To sort” zone for the rest. You can move or rename everything afterwards.
desktop.col.name: Name
desktop.menu.sort.name: Name
desktop.menu.inbox: “To sort” zone (receives the rest of the desktop)
desktop.detail.lockSub: Position, size and content are fixed
desktop.detail.inboxSub: Everything that is in no zone lands here
desktop.sub.inbox: Receives the rest of the desktop
desktop.pickZone: Pick a zone to adjust how it looks.
desktop.deleted: Zone “{name}” deleted. Its icons go back to “To sort”.
desktop.native.platform: Zones show as normal windows: Windows desktop features are only available on Windows.
desktop.native.off: Can't reach the Windows desktop: zones stay normal windows and Windows icons are not hidden.
desktop.draw.hint: Draw a rectangle to create a zone
desktop.draw.title: New zone
desktop.trashFailed: Couldn't move to the Recycle Bin
desktop.set.enabledSub: Shows zones on the desktop when MultiOutils starts
desktop.set.hideNativeSub: Zones then show every icon. They come back as soon as MultiOutils stops.
desktop.set.snapSub: Zones line up with each other and with screen edges
desktop.detail.rollSub: Only the title bar stays visible; the zone opens on hover
desktop.detail.keepOnHideSub: Stays visible when the desktop is hidden
desktop.peek.hint: Desktop peek: click anywhere to go back
desktop.tray.title: Desktop
desktop.rules.intro: Rules sort new items on their own. The first matching rule wins.
desktop.rules.empty.title: No rules yet
desktop.rules.empty.text: Example: every image goes to the Images zone, PDFs older than 30 days move to Documents\Archive.
desktop.rules.field.name: Name
desktop.rules.ph.name: invoice
desktop.rules.moveWarn: Files are really moved on disk. Every move is logged and can be undone.
desktop.log.intro: What the rules sorted or moved (last 200 actions).
desktop.log.clearConfirm: Clear the log? These actions can no longer be undone.
desktop.log.undoFailed: Can't undo: the item has changed since.
desktop.set.rollOpenSub: When the mouse is over it, after a short delay, or on click
desktop.set.autoRollEdge: Roll up at the top edge
desktop.set.autoRollEdgeSub: A zone placed against the top of the screen rolls up by itself
desktop.set.dblClickHideSub: Hides or shows the zones (only when Windows icons are hidden)
desktop.set.autoHideSub: Zones disappear when the desktop isn't being used
desktop.set.edgeRevealSub: Hidden zones come back when the mouse touches an edge
desktop.set.hotCornerSub: Pushing the mouse into this corner opens the peek
desktop.auto.title: Automatic page
desktop.auto.sub: Switches page by time of day or by the program in front. The first matching rule wins.
desktop.auto.needPages: Add a second page to switch pages automatically.
desktop.layout.intro: Save where your zones are to get it back later. A backup is made every day.
desktop.layout.noDaily: The first backup will be made today.
desktop.layout.restoreConfirm: Restore “{name}”? Current zones will be replaced.
desktop.layout.perScreensSub: When you plug or unplug a screen, zones go back to where they were in that setup
desktop.layout.swapped: Zones moved to the next screen
desktop.layout.importConfirm: Import a layout? Current zones will be replaced (you can undo).
desktop.layout.invalid: This file isn't a MultiOutils layout.
desktop.page.label: Pages
desktop.page.deleteConfirm: Delete page “{name}”? Its zones move to the first page.
desktop.page.allSub: The zone stays visible whatever the page
desktop.set.pageWheel: Mouse wheel on the empty desktop
desktop.set.pageIndicatorSub: Small dots at the bottom of the screen when the page changes
desktop.set.styleSub: Every zone follows these choices, except what you change in a zone.
desktop.style.title: Zone appearance
desktop.style.bgSub: By default, the MultiOutils theme glass
desktop.style.invisibleSub: The frame only shows on hover
desktop.style.altMove: Hidden bar: Alt + drag inside the zone to move it, right-click for its menu.
desktop.style.iconTintSub: Every icon takes the same colour
desktop.style.stripeSub: Thin band on the left, in the zone's colour
desktop.style.resetConfirm: Go back to the default appearance?
files.title: Files
files.addressHint: Double-click or Ctrl L to type a path
files.renameFail: Couldn't rename (name taken or invalid character)
files.tags.title: Tags ({n})
files.trashed: {n} item(s) moved to the Recycle Bin
files.clip.copied: {n} item(s) copied: Ctrl V to paste
files.clip.cut: {n} item(s) cut: Ctrl V to move
files.err.denied: Access to this folder was denied.
files.ocr.unsupported: This file isn't a readable image.
files.batch.title: Rename {n} items
files.batch.help: Tokens: {name}, {n} (number), {date} (modified date), {ext}. The extension is always kept.
files.batch.conflict: Some names clash: fix the pattern before applying.
files.dups.intro: Finds identical files (same content) in {dir} and its subfolders.
files.dups.trashConfirm: Move {n} copy(ies) to the Recycle Bin? One copy of each file is always kept.
files.clean.intro: Every day, old files in the chosen folders go to the Recycle Bin.
files.clean.none: No folder to clean. For example: Downloads, after 30 days.
files.clean.runConfirm: Move {n} item(s) to the Recycle Bin?
files.clean.done: {n} old item(s) moved to the Recycle Bin
files.trashView.intro: Items in the Windows Recycle Bin.
files.trashView.emptyConfirm: Empty the Recycle Bin? Files will be deleted for good.
desktop.preset.ha-chart.sub: Sensor trend for 24 hours or 7 days
desktop.preset.clips.sub: Your pinned clips, one click to copy
desktop.preset.cloud.sub: Drop: upload to your MultiOutils server
desktop.preset.notes.help: Type straight into the zone, everything is saved automatically.
desktop.preset.clips.help: The zone shows pinned clipboard items. One click copies them again.
desktop.preset.search.help: Type in the zone just like in the launcher: programs, files, maths, Home Assistant…
desktop.preset.cloud.help: Drop files on the zone: they go to your MultiOutils server, in clips, folder “Mini cloud”. Address and token: Settings → Remote server.
desktop.detail.shelfSub: Dropped files go to the Recycle Bin after this delay.
desktop.ha.pickHelp: Tick the devices and scenes to show in the zone ({n} chosen).
desktop.ha.notConfigured: Home Assistant isn't set up: Launcher → Home Assistant (address and token).
desktop.ha.none: No device chosen. Pick them in MultiOutils → Desktop.
desktop.clips.empty: Nothing pinned. Pin items in the MultiOutils clipboard.
desktop.cloud.title: Mini cloud
desktop.cloud.drop: Drop files here to send them to your server
desktop.cloud.notConfigured: MultiOutils server not set up: Settings → Remote server.
desktop.cloud.noFolders: Folders aren't sent: drop files (or a zip).
desktop.cloud.tooLarge: File too large for the server
desktop.set.contextMenuSub: “Create a zone” and “Desktop settings”. On Windows 11 they're under “Show more options”.
desktop.ai.title: Tidy-up suggested by AI
desktop.ai.intro: The AI looks at the names of desktop items (not their contents) and suggests zones. Nothing moves until you confirm; files stay on the desktop.
desktop.ai.emptyDesktop: The desktop is empty: nothing to tidy.
desktop.ai.noPlan: The AI didn't suggest a usable layout. Try again.
desktop.ai.noKey: No AI key: add one in Settings → AI translation.
settings.sd.title: Stream Deck plugin
settings.sd.how: Every MultiOutils version ships with its matching Stream Deck plugin. The button opens it in the Stream Deck app, which replaces the old version (accept its confirmation window). Your keys and their settings are kept.
settings.sd.upToDate: The Stream Deck plugin is up to date.
settings.sd.opened: Plugin sent to Stream Deck: confirm the install in its window.
